title: No, The Tank Is Not Dead.
summary: Armor expert The Chieftain explains why tanks still have a place on the modern battlefield despite drones and guided weapons. He responds to the 'tank is dead' debate, noting that tanks have been declared dead repeatedly since 1919.
why: Pointed to as an authoritative answer, from a former Abrams commander and tank historian, to claims that tanks are obsolete.

quote.text: I'd recommend this video by a former Abrams commander and tank historian who presents this argument far better than I can.
